rationale: The question is scientifically meaningful and actionable for selecting the strongest connected high-speed velocity region in the office. It faithfully preserves the target and scope, exposes all fixed operationalizations—including the threshold, six-neighbor connectivity, mean-location representation, and peak-speed strength measure—and correctly assigns the F1 responsibility to report location and strength. No unresolved operationalization is closed or unintended choice introduced. The task is answerable in principle, with coordinate and unit metadata limiting interpretation rather than preventing the analysis.
reviewed_model_visible_text: In the office velocity field, which contiguous ventilation region is strongest when high-speed airflow is defined as velocity magnitude above 0.20 in the stored velocity scale and locations connected through shared grid faces are treated as one region? Represent its location by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations, use peak speed as its strength measure, and report both the location and strength. Use six-neighbor connectivity along one grid axis.
